name: Tachibana
source:
She is a central figure the among young nurses. She is serious, responsible, and sincere about her work.

On the other hand, she sometimes demands the same seriousness from others, she sometimes neglects her personal life because she is working too hard.

[From [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/darkone/sakuseibyoto3/character/index.html]official site[/url]]
